name: code-style
description: Use this skill on every code change — even small snippets. Covers language-aware formatting, naming, documentation, organisation, and reuse. This is the baseline style guide for all code.
when: When formatting or organising code, naming things, or writing code comments
do-not-use-when: Reading or reviewing a file without proposing code changes
Editing prose-only Markdown where the writing skill is sufficient
Working in generated output that should not be edited directly
